Class BoardAnimationController

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.ui.effects.BoardAnimationController
public class BoardAnimationController extends Object
BoardAnimationController handles all visual animations and sound effects for row clears. This class is responsible for: - Playing row clear sound effects - Creating visual falling/fading animations for cleared row blocks - Board shake effects for multi-row clears This controller has no game logic - it only handles pure visual and audio effects.

    • animateClearedRows

      public void animateClearedRows(int[][] prevMatrix, ClearRow clearRow)
      Animates cleared rows with visual effects and plays sound.

      Creates a visual overlay of the cleared blocks and animates them falling and fading out. Also triggers a board shake effect for multi-row clears and plays the clear sound. This method is purely visual and does not affect the game state.

      Parameters:
      prevMatrix - The board matrix before rows were cleared.
      clearRow - Information about which rows were cleared.
